question:
Select the option that will fill in the blank and complete the given series.

6, 8, 12, 28, ______
solution:
The logic followed here is : Double addition pattern is followed here.

 
• First addition row → Square of the previous difference between two numbers is added subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80869ccc9519cf3f2d4e1cf905d37ed363d460af1f0669eccb64a67bb4fd5d0b.png] 

Hence, "284" is the correct answer.
